source.title: The Weir Group PLC interim results six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS 2619O, 29 July 2026)

adjusted_operating_margin_pct.source_definition: adjusted operating profit (before adjusting items and adjusting amortisation) / revenue, continuing operations
adjusted_operating_margin_pct.source: The Weir Group PLC interim results six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS 2619O, 29 July 2026)

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_definition: net debt (incl. IFRS 16 lease liabilities) / LTM adjusted EBITDA
net_debt_to_ebitda.source: The Weir Group PLC interim results six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS 2619O, 29 July 2026)
net_debt_to_ebitda.calculation_method: LTM adjusted EBITDA = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025 (APM note 2). Weir's headline 2.2x is on a lender-covenant basis and is not used.

free_cash_flow_margin_pct.source_definition: (net cash from operating activities - purchases of property, plant and equipment - purchases of intangible assets incl. capitalised development) / revenue; standardized across target and peers
free_cash_flow_margin_pct.source: The Weir Group PLC interim results six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS 2619O, 29 July 2026)
free_cash_flow_margin_pct.calculation_method: computed from the reported components in the calculation field
free_cash_flow_margin_pct.notes: IFRS: lease principal payments sit in financing cash flow. Operating cash flow is for total operations; revenue is continuing operations.

adjusted_eps_growth_pct.source: The Weir Group PLC interim results six months to 30 June 2026 (RNS 2619O, 29 July 2026)

adjusted_operating_margin_pct.calculation_method: computed from the reported components in the calculation field

free_cash_flow_margin_pct.calculation_method: computed from the reported components in the calculation field
free_cash_flow_margin_pct.notes: US GAAP: operating-lease payments are inside operating cash flow.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_definition: (debt due within one year + long-term debt - cash) / LTM (adjusted operating income + depreciation)
net_debt_to_ebitda.source: Flowserve Q2 2026 and Q4 2025 results (Form 8-K Exhibits 99.1)
net_debt_to_ebitda.calculation_method: LTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025. Adjusted operating income already excludes intangible amortization, so only depreciation is added back. Flowserve does not publish a leverage ratio in the release.
net_debt_to_ebitda.notes: LTM EBITDA is not pro-forma for the 2026 acquisitions (Greenray, Trillium Valves, FAMCO).
